title: Mock-Neck Crop & Grommet Cargo Pants
prompt: An original young woman with dark hair in a loose updo and sunglasses on her head stands against a white backdrop. She wears a fitted black long-sleeve mock-neck crop top with a small logo, paired with wide brown cargo trousers with grommet details, large patch pockets, and a black studded belt. Chunky black platform loafers complete the look. One arm is raised to her head. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of black, chocolate, and silver hardware. Sleek and utilitarian, in the style of a streetwear lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The grommets and cargo pockets are the defining utility details.
- Add 'full-length' to show the platform shoes.
tryThis: Try this: Use full-length framing to show the platform shoes.
